Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging

Interface StagingReleaseManager

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultStagingReleaseManager
    public interface StagingReleaseManager

    Functionality to manage releases that are accessible via the StagingResourceResolver or via replication .

    For a folder / site to be releasable its root has to have the mixin "cpl:releases". The release data is saved below /var/composum/{path to release root}/ that contains one subnode for each release. The current (open) release is named "current". This is the primary release the users work on. Each of these release nodes can contain metadata about the release, and below a subnode "root" a copy of the unversioned parts of the page tree with the "mix:versionable" nodes replaced by "cpl:VersionReference"s. 

     /var/composum/{path to release root}/
      "cpl:releases"/
         "current"/
               "root"
                   ... copy of the working tree for the release
             "metaData"
         otherrelase
             "root"
                 ... copy of the working tree for the release
             "metaData"

    We also set a label Release.getReleaseLabel() on each version contained in the release, for easier referencing versions.

    Each release references a Release.getPreviousRelease() from which it was created.

      • createRelease

        @NotNull
@Deprecated
@NotNull Release createRelease​(@NotNull
                               @NotNull Release copyFromRelease,
                               @NotNull
                               @NotNull ReleaseNumberCreator releaseType)
                        throws StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseExistsException,
                               org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException,
                               javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        Deprecated.
        in practice, finalizeCurrentRelease(Resource, ReleaseNumberCreator) should be used.
        Creates a release from another release. This also creates a new version number for that release based on the copied release - which can lead to conflicts ( StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseExistsException ) if there is already a release with that number.

        We cannot create a release from StagingConstants.CURRENT_RELEASE since that does not in the release number as tree concept, so an IllegalArgumentException would be thrown. For that use the conceptually different finalizeCurrentRelease(Resource, ReleaseNumberCreator).

        Parameters:
        copyFromRelease - an existing release, whose workspace is copied. Cannot be StagingConstants.CURRENT_RELEASE.
        releaseType - how to create the release number - major, minor or bugfix release
        Throws:
        StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseExistsException - if the release already exists
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException

      • compareReleases

        @NotNull
@NotNull List<ReleasedVersionable> compareReleases​(@NotNull
                                                   @NotNull Release release,
                                                   @Nullable
                                                   @Nullable Release previousRelease)
                                            throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        Compares a release to another release or to it's predecessor (if the parameter previousRelease is null). It returns a list of ReleasedVersionable wrt. {release} for which anything was changed - it does not distinguish whether the version is different, the path changed or whether it's new or removed, except that the ReleasedVersionable.versionUuid is null if it was removed.
        Parameters:
        release - the release to compare
        previousRelease - optional, a specific release to compare to. If null, we take the previous release, if there is one. If there is no previous release too, we return the release contents (all new).
        Returns:
        The list of changes
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException

      • updateRelease

        @NotNull
@NotNull Map<String,​SiblingOrderUpdateStrategy.Result> updateRelease​(@NotNull
                                                                           @NotNull Release release,
                                                                           @NotNull
                                                                           @NotNull List<ReleasedVersionable> releasedVersionableList)
                                                                    throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                                                                           org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException,
                                                                           StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException,
                                                                           ReleaseChangeFailedException
        Updates the release by adding or updating a number of versionables denoted by {releasedVersionable} in the release. If ReleasedVersionable.versionUuid is null, it is removed from the release. We also set a label "composum-release-"{releasenumber} on each version contained in the release, for easier referencing versions. Caution: the current release is called "composum-release-"current . This needs the workspace to copy the attributes and node orderings of the parent nodes from - the paths of the releasedVersionableList must correspond to the workspace.
        Parameters:
        release - the release to update
        releasedVersionableList - a number of paths to versionables for which the version denoted by ReleasedVersionable.versionUuid version should be put into the release, or to be removed when it's null.
        Returns:
        a map with paths where we changed the order of children in the release.
        Throws:
        StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseClosedException - if the release is Release.isClosed()
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException
        ReleaseChangeFailedException

      • deleteRelease

        void deleteRelease​(@NotNull
                   @NotNull Release release)
            throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                   org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException,
                   StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseProtectedException
        Deletes a unmarked release. If you want to delete a release marked with setMark(String, Release, boolean), you have to deleteMark(String, Release) first. Deleting the StagingConstants.CURRENT_RELEASE is also possible, though it'll be recreated automatically when calling one of the get / find release methods.
        Parameters:
        release - the release, as given by findRelease(Resource, String) or findReleaseByUuid(Resource, String).
        Throws:
        org.apache.sling.api.resource.PersistenceException - can happen e.g. when deleting a release that is referenced somewhere
        StagingReleaseManager.ReleaseProtectedException - if a release that has Release.getMarks() shall be deleted.
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException
